summary: Phase 3 backend and frontend testing completed. Backend: 30/39 tests passed (76.9%). Fixed critical permission bug (dealer territories access) and status code issues. Frontend: Theme toggle, navigation, and role-based UI verified working. Modal overlay issue prevents full territory creation flow testing.

minor_issues.impact: Test script issue only - exports are working correctly
minor_issues.status: Not a bug - test script limitation

fixed_bugs.fix: Added 'territories.read' permission to dealer role in permissions.py

fixed_bugs.issue: POST endpoints returning 200 instead of 201 for resource creation
fixed_bugs.fix: Added status_code=201 to POST routes for users, products, territories, reports

ui_bugs.issue: Modal overlay blocks navigation clicks after opening 'New territory' dialog
ui_bugs.impact: Cannot navigate away from Territories page after opening dialog without closing it first
ui_bugs.workaround: Press Escape or click Cancel to close dialog
